claim: Under both rank and weighted-moment credit normalization, the scalar proportional rule has exactly one feasible omitted pair and its maximum prefix residual is strictly above 1/2.
construction: legacy x and right order; replace only d_4 by the exact value solving the weighted moment for O={2,4}

full_row_handling.proportional_objective: evaluate both L:k and R:k; equality makes duplication objective-neutral
full_row_handling.unrestricted_support_lp: deduplicate identical item sets; retain the full row once

objective.fixed_support_code: minimize over normalized credits the maximum prefix residual
objective.global_code: minimize fixed-support value over all 2-element omitted sets
objective.infeasible_support_handling: exclude supports failing either credit normalization; if none are feasible, report no-feasible-proportional-support, not a finite optimum
objective.proportional_code: minimize over all 2-element omitted sets the maximum residual using proportional_credit_code

residual.expanded_code: sum(d[i] * (x[i] - credit[i]) for i in prefix if i not in omitted) - sum(d[i] * (1 - x[i]) for i in prefix if i in omitted)
residual.full_row_assertion_code: sum(d[i] * (u[i] - f[i]) for i in range(k)) == 0
residual.prefix_code: sum(d[i] * (u[i] - f[i]) for i in prefix)

support_and_credit_normalization.credit_domain_code: credit[i] >= 0 for i in selected; credit[i] = 0 for i in omitted
support_and_credit_normalization.proportional_alpha_code: alpha = (2 - sum(x[j] for j in omitted)) / (3 - sum(x[j] for j in omitted))
support_and_credit_normalization.proportional_credit_code: credit[i] = 0 if i in omitted else x[i] / (3 - sum(x[j] for j in omitted))
support_and_credit_normalization.proportional_feasibility_code: credit[i] = x[i] / (3 - sum(x[j] for j in omitted)) on selected; both credit_sum_code and weighted_credit_sum_code must hold
support_and_credit_normalization.selected_set_code: selected = [i for i in range(k) if i not in omitted]
support_and_credit_normalization.u_code: u[i] = 0 if i in omitted else 1 - credit[i]
support_and_credit_normalization.weighted_credit_sum_code: sum(d[i] * credit[i] for i in selected) == sum(d[i] * x[i] for i in range(k)) - sum(d[i] for i in omitted)
